gap: No result ChatGPT got states that third-party Qi2.2 25W magnetic chargers for the home half of the set need a 45W-or-higher USB-C supply (UGREEN's MagFlow Pro pages say '45W Adapter Required' and '45W+ Input for 25W'), not the 30W Apple specifies for its own puck, or that on a multi-port brick like the UGREEN Nexode 100W only ports C1/C2 can supply that, because C3 and USB-A top out at 22.5W.
standout_why: Compared against Apple Support 105047 (cited; read en-us), the Anker MagSafe car-mount guide (rank 11 in one chat, not cited) and Macworld's best MagSafe chargers page (rank 9, not cited). Apple's page gives 30W for 25W charging, but only for Apple's own MagSafe Charger. It does not mention Qi2/Qi2.2 third-party chargers, car chargers or iOS versions. The Anker guide already says a car mount needs 'Rated input of 45W or higher' and should not be powered from the car's built-in USB-C port. That covers the car half, so 45W is only partly new. Macworld lists 'Includes 45W charger' for two Belkin picks, but only as a product bullet, and never says a 25W puck needs 45W. None of the three says that home Qi2.2 pucks and stands from UGREEN need 45W rather than 30W. None says which port on a multi-port brick can power them. ChatGPT's own answer told the shopper 'A 30W or higher compatible USB-C adapter', which undersizes a UGREEN or ESR set.
kit_items: Home magnetic stand: UGREEN MagFlow Pro Qi2 25W 2-in-1 Wireless Charger with Cooling ($99.99), or the MagFlow Pro Qi2 25W 3-in-1 ($159.99) to add Apple Watch. Both are Qi2.2 25W with a fan, and UGREEN's page says 25W needs 45W+ input.

Home wall adapter with a 45W+ port: UGREEN Nexode 65W 3-Port Charger ($36.49). Each USB-C port is rated to 65W max. Plug the stand in alone or into C1/C2. Dealectric already lists ugreen-nexode-65w-3-port-charger and ugreen-nexode-100w-4-port-gan-charger. On the 100W model, use C1/C2 only, because C3 is 22.5W max.

Car magnetic charger: UGREEN MagFlow Pro Qi2 25W Magnetic Car Charger with Cooling ($49.99, already listed as ugreen-magflow-pro-qi2-25w-car-charger-cooling). Sold on the same store as the stand, so one cart.

Car 12V adapter: UGREEN Nexode Car Charger 145W with Retractable USB-C Cable ($49.99), or the already-listed ugreen-150w-usb-c-car-charger-4-port. Anker's guide says a car's built-in USB-C port is not enough for a 25W mount, so plan on a 12V-socket PD adapter.

Alternative single-SKU set: ESR 25W CryoBoost 3-in-1 Magnetic Charger (Qi2) and Car Charger (Air Vent) Bundle, $149.13. It covers home and car in one link, but still needs a car power source, and the clip fits blade vents only (10–32 mm wide, 1–4 mm thick; no round or bladeless vents).
